paper_mapping.environment: SharedKitchen commit de37e0818c2e76311e105ab8689e5162bd84133f; vector observation 866, centralized state 863; spatial 3x26x7x7 validated and not consumed by this method.
paper_mapping.policy: Shared per-member MAPPO actor; 2x64 ELU MLP, local obs + role one-hot + independent episode z8 -> action logits.
paper_mapping.sp_objective: PPO/GAE maximizes self-play shared team reward; one centralized state critic per member.
paper_mapping.xp_objective: PPO/GAE reverses the policy-gradient sign on the sampled highest-return XP partner.
paper_mapping.xp_critics: One independent centralized state critic per possible partner, updated on its XP rollout.
paper_mapping.latent_mi: Independent categorical z8 per chef and episode; q(z|obs, role one-hot, action_probs) CE trains q and actor.
paper_mapping.population: Each XP rollout has one focal A policy in a rotating role and frozen B policy in the other two roles.
paper_mapping.xp_selection: Approximate max-compatible selection over a shuffled, no-replacement candidate cycle; recorded per update.
paper_mapping.warm_start: Every actor is initialized with behavior cloning; random independent z8 and the role bits in the native vector are the only policy inputs added.
paper_mapping.warmup: XP policy-gradient and MI coefficients ramp linearly from zero to their configured values over the first 10% of RL environment steps.

best_checkpoint_policy.criterion: highest mean_team_score on standard SharedKitchen evaluation
best_checkpoint_policy.tie_rule: on an exact score tie, keep the later iteration

checkpoint_policy.demonstration_steps_counted_once: BC initialization across population members does not multiply environment transitions
checkpoint_policy.alignment: step thresholds are checked after complete population updates; the archive is named with the actual total_env_steps at the first update boundary meeting or exceeding a threshold
checkpoint_policy.step_snapshots: save step_<actual_total_env_steps>.pt at each 250000-step threshold after a complete population update
checkpoint_policy.final_snapshot: save final.pt and step_<actual_total_env_steps>.pt at stop
checkpoint_policy.archive_overwrite: existing run directories are rejected; existing archive names are skipped
